items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: Oh, we had a guitar player. What was his name? And a blues singer, too.

ctx.x: In that time, Cootie, who was doing any vocals for you then? With the seven pieces.
Oh, we had a guitar player. What was his name? And a blues singer, too. He played the guitar. I'll think of his name after awhile.
All right. Funny, I'm not sure. You don't know who he worked with --
